text:
maria: Quick handoff from me — day shift. Incident: sporadic 504s hitting /v1/regen in eu-west1 ~03:10-03:25. Prob root cause: transient k8s pod restart + long GC on a small pool. Mitigations: scaled regen pool to 6, tweaked liveness probe, enabled short-circuit fallback to small-model variant. Observability: added quick tracing tag regen_request_id. Logs excerpt:
```ERROR: handler timeout=30s req=abcd1234 pod=redwood-serve-5gc```
Next steps: watch p50/p95 latency for 30m, move canary to 5% rollout if stable, ping infra if preemption recurs. I'm OOO at 20:00 PT.

kevin: Thanks — can you drop the infra ticket id for follow-up?

maria: sure — INFRA-4127. Added note about liveness tweak.

raj: I'm on nightshift, will watch for 504s. If it spikes >1.5% over baseline I'll rollback canary to 0.1% and requeue pods. Can you paste the rollback command here?

maria: Rollback command (ops jumpbox):
```bash
kubectl -n redwood rollout undo deployment/regen-canary --to-revision=3
```

esther: FYI embeddings ingest backlog at ~03:40 caused CPU thrashing on embed-workers; I drained one worker to stop the loop. Disk IO looks elevated, watching.

oncall-bot: Alert: regen-504-rate (eu-west1) status: resolved (recovery detected ~1h ago). Next automated check in 15m. Details: https://monitoring/redwood/alerts/regen-504

kevin: LGTM. Ping me if rollback happens, I'll coordinate with SRE for a capacity bump.

raj: I'll be running a quick smoke pump every 2m for the next hour: `curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/regen -d '{"prompt":"ping"}'` — will report if any 5xx seen.

maria: :thumbsup: leaving notes in the handoff doc: https://app.docs/ops/handoffs/1769999999

esther: One blocker to call out: storage team says shard compaction for the embed index may run ~45m. If it overlaps peak we should postpone. I'll update the compaction schedule and tag infra.

kevin: :eyes: thanks all. No further asks from me right now.
